model_annotation: This plot illustrates the percentage of workers with different migration backgrounds over time. The x-axis is labeled "Alter" and represents age in years, with a linear scale ranging from 20 to 70. Tick labels are present at every 10-year interval. The y-axis is labeled "Anteil Erwerbstätige in %" and represents the percentage of workers, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100. A black solid line, labeled "ohne Migrationshintergrund," begins at approximately 63% at 20 years and decreases to approximately 15% at 70 years, exhibiting fluctuations throughout the range. A gray solid line, labeled "in Deutschland geboren," starts at approximately 72% at 20 years and decreases to approximately 22% at 70 years, also showing fluctuations. A blue solid line, labeled "zugewandert bis 2009," begins at approximately 45% at 20 years and decreases to approximately 10% at 70 years, with a more pronounced undulating pattern. A light blue solid line, labeled "zugewandert seit 2010," starts at approximately 50% at 20 years and decreases to approximately 5% at 70 years, also exhibiting fluctuations.
